title: TelemetryBatchEnvelopeV1
description: Metadata mapped to provider headers or attributes. The original gzip payload is carried separately as native message-body bytes and is never Base64 wrapped on the wire.

batchId.description: Nonempty UUID; the all-zero UUID is rejected by runtime validation.

receivedAt.description: The JSON model uses date-time. Provider publishers encode UTC using .NET round-trip O format with seven fractional digits; consumers require that provider encoding.
